name: Discover Storeleads Companies
runs_on: a Storeleads search, which is its source: the filter set on the launch row. Storeleads has no saved query, so the filters ARE the query; the pull walks it page by page (50 a page, 10 pages a batch) until the cap or the last page
reads: the search's answers; the held Companies at those domains; the DNC table
creates: nothing of its own: the register's landing columns and the Storeleads extras group must exist (scaffold the base with Extras = Storeleads); an open key in the pull is created as a column and its People lookup by the preflight
held_value: overwrite on a new pull (Storeleads is fresher); Domain Source on create only; Tag re-stamped
providers: Storeleads; no credential, a dead API or error pages twice on a cursor is a logged skip that drops that query, the row closes Failed only when nothing at all could be pulled
logs: the launch row only: pulled, kept, landed (new, refreshed), emails, batches, columns created, skips, early stops, failures; then Enrich Contacts fired once on Not Sourced scoped to this pull's domains
handoff: Enrich Contacts, once, on Companies view Not Sourced scoped to this pull's domains (unscoped past the 20,000-domain scope cap, which the log names)
